summary: Collected job postings from the first two pages of https://news.ycombinator.com/jobs (clicked 'More' once) into jobs.csv with columns title, link (HN discussion URL containing item?id=), and age. Used extract_table to determine cell/link numbering on each page, then paginate_extract with link_match='ago' to correctly capture the discussion link for both normal listings (which have a domain link + age link) and self-posted listings (which only have a title link + age link, no separate domain link
